data.title: Medical Management Model
data.description: Healthy Blue utilization management and member-centric care management models.
data.content: The Utilization Management Program uses an integrated medical management model based on members' physical, behavioral, and social needs. Care management includes early identification, continuous assessment, provider collaboration, individualized care plans, and medically necessary care in the least-restrictive setting.
